name: sys_fieldbus_dead
notes: 0 when every planned device is talking

name: sys_fieldbus_crc
notes: rising means the line: termination, stub length, or the wrong baud

name: sys_fieldbus_stray
desc: bytes that arrived out of turn
notes: rising means a second master, a duplicate address, or a device answering after its turn had passed

name: sys_now_ms
desc: the scan clock, milliseconds since boot
notes: ST blocks difference it themselves; wraps at ~49 days and unsigned subtraction carries it

name: sys_today
desc: days since 1 Jan 1970, 0 before the clock is set
notes: the wall clock as a DATE; a schedule counts in these and cannot run on 0

name: sol_ready
desc: the solar tracker has a location and a clock
notes: one row, not one per solar output: they all go together, and every boot passes through this until NTP lands

name: sol_fromRise_min
desc: minutes since sunrise; negative before it
notes: what the sol_ phase offsets are measured against

name: sol_fromSet_min
desc: minutes since sunset; negative before it
notes: held until the tracker has a location and a wall clock

name: sol_elev_deg
desc: the sun's elevation above the horizon
notes: negative below it; what the day's shape is anticipated from
